note: What a place can put in front of a character. A beat is anchored to a location and is true while the character is in that location's district; the engine picks it deterministically from the day, so nothing here is a roll and nothing here is the narrator's decision. Anchored by TAG rather than by key wherever the beat is not about one specific venue, so a beat written once works in every district that has the ground for it.
capNote: How many place beats may be live at once. Two. The Life funnel scores them against rent, wounds and people like everything else, and a place that offers four things at once is a quest board.

beats.title: The water truck didn't make it today
beats.summary: The carwash is selling clean drinking water. The line runs half the block and it is not getting shorter.

beats.title: The elevator is dead again
beats.summary: The building manager wants thirty a resident toward parts. Until somebody pays, it is the stairs.

beats.title: Somebody is moving in two containers down
beats.summary: A family, by the look of the load. Half the terrace has come out to watch and nobody is offering to help.

beats.title: The reclaimers need hands
beats.summary: Somebody destroyed three of the rooftop growing beds in the night. Nobody there thinks it was random.

beats.title: Night market in the west concourse
beats.summary: One of the Fixers running the place has opened it up for the evening. Word is somebody is carrying military-grade optics.

beats.title: The queue for clean water goes round the block
beats.summary: Whatever went wrong upstream, it has not been fixed, and the people at the front got there hours ago.

beats.title: There has been a cancellation
beats.summary: Somebody with an appointment did not turn up, and somebody else is going to take the slot.

beats.title: Somebody has been stripping the place
beats.summary: Copper, mostly, and whatever else came away with it. The work is recent enough to still be going on.

beats.title: There is a toll on this street today
beats.summary: Not a robbery. A price, quoted politely, by people who are standing where you need to walk.

beats.title: The water pressure has gone again
beats.summary: Everyone on this side of the stack is carrying bottles up. Somebody says it is the pump; somebody says it is the bill.

beats.title: They are short of hands
beats.summary: Not enough people for what needs doing before dark, and they are asking anyone standing nearby.

beats.title: A container came in that nobody has papers for
beats.summary: It is sitting where it was dropped. Two people are already arguing about whose problem that makes it.

beats.title: Somebody has been asking about you in here
beats.summary: Not by name. By description, which is worse, and whoever it was did not leave one of their own.

beats.title: A floor is being emptied
beats.summary: Crates, shredders, and people carrying their own chairs out. Nobody upstairs will say whether it is a move or a cut.

beats.title: Somebody's badge has stopped working
beats.summary: They are still at the barrier arguing about it, and the queue behind them has started to take an interest.

beats.title: The results came back wrong
beats.summary: Somebody wants a second pair of hands and no questions before the morning shift arrives and reads the log.

beats.title: They are looking for somebody who was there
beats.summary: A producer is paying for a first-hand account and is not fussy about whose hands it came through on the way.

beats.title: The precinct is running a sweep
beats.summary: Vans out front and a list somebody has been adding to all week. Being near the front steps today is a decision.

beats.title: The queue reaches the door
beats.summary: Whatever they are processing today, everybody in the district needs it, and there are two windows open.

beats.title: There is something on this evening
beats.summary: A lecture, a recital or a demonstration, and the doors are open to anyone willing to sit at the back.

beats.title: The line is down again
beats.summary: Nobody has said for how long. Half the platform has given up and started walking; the other half is still hoping.

beats.title: A transfer is being held
beats.summary: Nothing is wrong with it, they say. It is being reviewed, and reviews take exactly as long as they take.

beats.title: Somebody is moving out at three in the morning
beats.summary: Quietly, thoroughly, and with rather more people helping than a move of this size ought to need.

beats.title: A room has gone unclaimed
beats.summary: Paid up through the week and nobody has been back to it. The desk would rather it were somebody else's problem.

beats.title: They are short in the kitchen tonight
beats.summary: Somebody did not turn up, the room is full, and the person asking has stopped caring about your references.

beats.title: The night shift is short again
beats.summary: They will take anybody who can stay upright for eight hours, and they will not ask a great deal beyond that.

beats.title: There is a service this evening
beats.summary: The doors are open, and the room fills with people who would not otherwise stand in the same building.

beats.title: The waiting room has stopped moving
beats.summary: Something came in that took the whole department. Everybody else is sitting exactly where they were an hour ago.

beats.title: They are rehearsing with the doors open
beats.summary: Not a performance, and better than one: somebody inside is trying something that is not working yet.

beats.title: The families are moving on
beats.summary: Packing has started, the argument about the route is well underway, and nobody has said how long they will be gone.

signalNote: The mark a beat wears on the map, from the closed list in placeSignals.ts. Omitted, a beat is an event (or a person, when its category is people) — a beat has to ask to be anything more eye-catching than a warning.
